evidence.quote: Imogen Hopper Compliance Analyst Imogen joined Trinity Street in February 2026 and is based in the London office. Prior to Trinity Street, she worked in Compliance at a London-based investment manager and as Listing Officer at the Ministry of Justice. Imogen holds a BSc in International Development from the University of Reading.
